title: MCU: An Evaluation Framework for Open-Ended Game Agents

layout.note: Three stacked full-width bands: the pipeline (a) with an upper row of three stages and a lower row for MineStudio and the agent set, the source-sunburst-challenges row (b), and a bottom strip of three chart panels (c, d, e).

lesson: Compose a benchmark overview as lettered bands: the pipeline with real text samples on stacked cards on top, a central taxonomy chart bracketed between its data sources and the real-world meaning of its categories, and a strip of small result charts that each back one claim. A cross and tick on loop arrows shows verify-and-refine without extra boxes.
